#### fresh generation
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  swiftlint:
    name: Swift Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Swiftlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/swiftlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  swift_unit_tests:
    name: Swift Unit Tests
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES != '1' || needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1' || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS == '1')}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: CocoaPods
      shell: bash
      run: pod install
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: XCTest
      shell: bash
      run: swift test
    - name: Licenses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/soup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        parameters: "--no_prompt"
#### files
.github/workflows/auto-approve.yml
.github/workflows/build.yml
.semgrepignore

#### regeneration over a customized build.yml
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CUSTOM_WORKFLOW_ENV: kept
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:
    name: Github Actions Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Actionlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/actionlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  swiftlint:
    name: Swift Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Swiftlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/swiftlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  swift_unit_tests:
    name: Swift Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES != '1' || needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1' || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS == '1') || (needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS == '1')}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: CocoaPods
      shell: bash
      run: pod install --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: XCTest
      shell: bash
      run: swift test --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Licenses
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/soup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        parameters: "--no_prompt"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
